test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Copying someone else's work and trying to submit as your own
solution:
The correct answer is** "Plagiarism".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Plagiarism** means copying **someone else's work and trying to pass it off as your own.** 
 
• It is a **serious academic offense and can result in penalties or even expulsion. **
 
• **Plagiarism** can be avoided by** properly citing sources and using quotation marks for direct quotes. **
 
• The word comes from the Latin word **"plagiarius," meaning "kidnapper."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2, **Hooliganism,** refers to rowdy, violent behavior in public places. -
 
• Option 3,** Altruism, **means selfless concern for the welfare of others. -
 
• Option 4,** Cynicism,** is a belief that people are motivated purely by self-interest and distrust of others' motives. -
